latest.title: Curvature growth and holomorphic splitting for Kähler metrics with cone singularities
latest.abstract: We study Kähler metrics with cone angle $2πβ$ along a smooth divisor, in the range $1/2<β<1$. We show that bounded Riemann curvature near the divisor forces the normal bundle sequence to split holomorphically, confirming a condition proposed by Donaldson.
latest.workSummary: 证明锥角介于 π 与 2π 的 Kähler 锥度量若曲率有界，则除子法丛序列全纯分裂。
latest.breakthrough: 确认 Donaldson 提出的必要结构条件。
latest.limitations: 仅此角度范围及光滑除子；必要条件不能写成充分条件。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
latest.aiEvidence: 正文披露与 ChatGPT 讨论时得到关键局部曲率渐近式，作者随后核查发展。
latest.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.07494v1（AI 声明/致谢；涉及摘要者同时核对元数据）
latest.priorityReason: 奇异曲率与复结构之间的刚性联系重要。
